varnished hardwood.source: Density: hardwood 600-800 kg/m³. Bounce chosen so a superball on it gives Cross's measured 0.86.

varnished hardwood [a50e1c].source: Density: hardwood 600-800 kg/m³. Bounce chosen so a superball on it gives Cross's measured 0.86.

aluminium [bcbdb6].source: Aluminium 2700 kg/m³. Friction on wood and bounce provisional.

ABS plastic.source: ABS 1040-1060 kg/m³ (what LEGO bricks are made of); plastic on wood friction about 0.3. A hard molded part lands with e about 0.5: provisional.

low-carbon steel.source: Low-carbon steel wire and sheet, 7850 kg/m³; µ0·M_s ≈ 2.0 T [CHIKAZUMI]. Bounce provisional.

optical glass.source: N-BK7 crown glass 2510 kg/m³ (SCHOTT data sheet); glass on glass friction about 0.4 (Engineering ToolBox); bounce provisional.

ceramic magnet [4571b0].source: Ceramic 8 (Y30) ferrite: B_r 0.385-0.40 T, 4.9 g/cm³ [ARN]. Friction and bounce provisional.

ABS housing.source: ABS plastic 1040-1060 kg/m³ (a torch's or meter's housing; friction and bounce provisional).

glass.source: Soda-lime glass 2500 kg/m³; glass on glass, kinetic friction about 0.4 (Engineering ToolBox). Hard, so a high bounce: provisional.

varnished hardwood [0b1db0].source: Density: hardwood 600-800 kg/m³. Bounce chosen so a superball on it gives Cross's measured 0.86.

carpet.source: Pile carpet, bulk density about 200 kg/m³ (provisional); a ball rolls with large resistance on it. Bounce and friction provisional.

steel.source: Carbon steel 7850 kg/m³; hard steel-on-steel restitution about 0.9-0.95 at low speed.

steel [b760e9].source: Carbon steel 7850 kg/m³; hard steel-on-steel restitution about 0.9-0.95 at low speed.

brick [213d7e].source: Common clay brick 1600-2000 kg/m³ (Engineering ToolBox); brick on wood friction about 0.6. Rigid (10-20 GPa, like concrete), so a ball bounces off it: 0.95 provisional. A flat block landing on it is dead (see _pairs).

steel weight [371bbc].source: Weights are made to a conventional density of 8000 kg/m³ (OIML R 111); steel on wood friction about 0.4. A big flat block lands dead: bounce provisional.

hollow plastic.source: Polyethylene 910-960 kg/m³; e from a 92 cm drop rebounding 43.6 cm with drag removed (Physics Factbook).

concrete [e038e2].source: Concrete 2400 kg/m³; concrete on wood friction about 0.6 (Engineering ToolBox). Very rigid: ball bounce is the ball's own.

leather (basketball) [75cde4].source: FIBA size 7: 24.0-24.8 cm, 567-650 g; from 1.80 m (its bottom) it rebounds 1.20-1.40 m (its top), so e = sqrt((1.30 - 0.242) / 1.8) = 0.77. Wall provisional.

granite [2dae7e].source: Granite 2630-2750 kg/m³ (Engineering ToolBox); a river pebble. Bounce provisional.

varnished hardwood [608d19].source: Density: hardwood 600-800 kg/m³. Bounce chosen so a superball on it gives Cross's measured 0.86.

tissue paper [f24506].source: A rolled paper roll is about 100-150 kg/m³ (provisional, from a roll's weight and size). Soft: almost no bounce, a larger rolling resistance 0.015 (provisional).

aluminium.source: Aluminium 2700 kg/m³. Friction on wood and bounce provisional.

cardboard [50c333].source: Effective density of an EMPTY corrugated box (board about 0.45 kg/m², so a 30 x 20 x 20 cm box weighs about 0.3 kg): provisional.

varnished hardwood [33ba6c].source: Density: hardwood 600-800 kg/m³. Bounce chosen so a superball on it gives Cross's measured 0.86.

steel [2d96e0].source: Carbon steel 7850 kg/m³; hard steel-on-steel restitution about 0.9-0.95 at low speed.

steel [c638cb].source: Carbon steel 7850 kg/m³; hard steel-on-steel restitution about 0.9-0.95 at low speed.

low-carbon steel [db88d7].source: Low-carbon steel wire and sheet, 7850 kg/m³; µ0·M_s ≈ 2.0 T [CHIKAZUMI]. Bounce provisional.

low-carbon steel [3ed971].source: Low-carbon steel wire and sheet, 7850 kg/m³; µ0·M_s ≈ 2.0 T [CHIKAZUMI]. Bounce provisional.

hot plate.source: A lab hot plate's enamelled steel case (fixed in place).

box acrylic.source: Acrylic (PMMA) 1180 kg/m³ [CRC]; bounce and friction provisional.

mirror glass.source: Soda-lime glass 2500 kg/m³, back-silvered; friction and bounce as glass (provisional).

ceramic magnet.source: Ceramic 8 (Y30) ferrite: B_r 0.385-0.40 T, 4.9 g/cm³ [ARN]. Friction and bounce provisional.
